A moment later it reads "Pickup code sent to Flat 302", "SMS delivered to the Rao family" and "The code is valid until Thu 5 Nov, 14:30, counted from the drop.", 48 hours after the 14:30 drop on Tuesday.
exact_words: Sending the pickup code to Flat 302
SMS delivered to the Rao family
The code is valid until Thu 5 Nov, 14:30, counted from the drop.

reason: The moving dots while the message is sending are an animation.

test: when the drop is done the pickup code appears nowhere on the courier's screen
what_should_happen: The pickup code goes only to the resident's phone. When the drop is finished, its six digits appear nowhere on the courier's screen, neither together nor in two groups of three.

test: "See as resident" for a parcel to 304 opens /resident?flat=304 as the Chawla family
what_should_happen: After a parcel for flat 304 is delivered, the courier clicks "See as resident". The address becomes /resident?flat=304, the page says "Hello, Chawla family" and the header shows the Chawla family.

test: OK takes the step panel away and leaves the form unlocked and empty
what_should_happen: When the drop is done, pressing OK takes the step panel away and "Your locker appears here" is back. The form is unlocked again, with no size chosen and an empty flat box.
exact_words: Put the parcel in the locker

test: the title row goes from "0 dropped this round" to "2 dropped this round" after two lockers are given
what_should_happen: The courier's page opens with "0 dropped this round" in the title row. After one drop is finished and a second locker is given, it reads "2 dropped this round".

test: leaving the courier's page and coming back starts the count again at 0
what_should_happen: After one drop the title row reads "1 dropped this round". Going home and coming back as Imran starts the count again at "0 dropped this round".

test: after a parcel has gone into D21, the wall shows D21 holding
what_should_happen: A parcel has just gone into D21. Going home and on to Farida's wall, door D21 is shown holding a parcel.
